instruction: Add an image using the <img> tag with any image URL you like. Important: Set the alt text exactly to: "A random picture"

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: You've successfully added an image with proper alt text! The <img> tag with src and alt attributes is essential for accessible web design.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: Remember: Use <img src="YOUR_IMAGE_URL_HERE" alt="A random picture">. Make sure to include both the src attribute (with any image URL) and the alt attribute with the exact text "A random picture".
